results.name: shop/api

error.Text: Service has no endpoints, expected label app=api-v2

results.details:
Error: The Service cannot find any Pods because no Pods have the label "app=api-v2" that the Service is looking for.

Solution:
1. Check Pod labels: kubectl get pods --show-labels
2. Add missing label to Pods: kubectl label pods <pod-name> app=api-v2
3. Verify: kubectl get endpoints

results.name: shop/redis

error.Text: Service shop/redis has event Cluster IP [IPv4]: 10.96.237.59 is not allocated; repairing

results.details:
Error: The Kubernetes service has an IP address that wasn't properly allocated from the cluster's IP pool, causing a mismatch in IP management.

Solution:
1. Delete the service: `kubectl delete svc redis -n shop`
2. Recreate it: `kubectl apply -f redis-service.yaml`
3. Verify: `kubectl get svc redis -n shop`
